from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from lookup import bookings_for

KEY = ROWS[0][0]
COUNT = sum(1 for k, _ in ROWS if k == KEY)


def test_upper_case_with_spaces():
    assert len(bookings_for(list(load_bookings()), " " + KEY.upper() + " ")) == COUNT


def test_exact():
    assert len(bookings_for(list(load_bookings()), KEY)) == COUNT
